data.gender_notes: Lubaib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'l-b-b' meaning to be generous, or wealthy, Lubaib is a name of noble origin, evoking images of wisdom and intellect. It is a name that speaks of abundance and prosperity, both material and spiritual. The name Lubaib carries the meaning “Wealthy, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Lubaib usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the abundance of divine blessings and the generosity of Allah.
data.etymology: Lubaib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealthy, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lubaib total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_urdu.name: لبيب
in_urdu.long_meaning: لبيب ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے ذہین اور سمجھدار، یہ نام برصغیر پاک و ہند میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے اور اسے اکثر بچوں کے لیے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے
